messages.原文或样式已变化，请重新预览: Source text or styles changed. Preview again.

messages.请划选一处文字，完成后退出: Select one passage; exits when done
messages.无法从旧颜色判断创建来源。勾选需要转换的颜色，选择思源预设或设置浅深两色，再预览: Old colors do not reveal their origin. Select colors to convert, choose a SiYuan preset or set light and dark colors, then preview and confirm. Document repair includes unloaded annotations and can be undone in one step.
messages.建议使用与当前颜色完全一致的思源预设；勾选后才会转换。: Suggested SiYuan preset exactly matches the current color; conversion requires selecting the checkbox.
messages.没有可修复的固定色；当前文档需先打开并等待索引完成。: No fixed colors to repair. Open a document and wait for indexing before repairing its colors.
messages.请预览确认；内容、工具、主题或映射变化后需重新预览。: Preview before confirming. Changes to content, tools, theme or mappings require a new preview.
messages.请先勾选要修复的颜色: Select the colors to repair first
messages.请输入有效的浅色和深色颜色: Enter valid light and dark colors
messages.工具备份无效或不存在: Tool backup is missing or invalid
messages.原生样式已删除，请重新选择: Native style deleted; choose another style
messages.当前宿主仅支持内置样式，请升级思源: Only built-in styles are available; update SiYuan
messages.配色和样式在思源文字样式面板中管理: Manage colors and styles in SiYuan’s text style panel
messages.勾选旧颜色，选择要关联的思源原生颜色，再预览确认。正文修复包含未加载的标注，可一: Select old colors and the native SiYuan colors to link them to, then review the preview. Repairs include unloaded annotations and support one-step undo.
messages.原生样式暂不可用，请同步后重试: Native style unavailable; sync and try again
messages.整批修改可在正文中一次撤销: Undo the entire batch in one step in the document
messages.完全采用目标样式，将匹配的标注统一为所选样式。: Apply the selected target style to every matching annotation.
messages.选择样式后，这里会显示修改前后的效果: Choose styles to compare their appearance before and after.
messages.当前选择不会改变标注样式: The selected styles produce no changes
